product_wide_rationale: Defines the Domain model itself, including what a Domain is and how law homes to one. A record that creates the partition cannot be owned by a Domain inside it.
summary: Makes Product law and architectural concordance Priority 1; canonical Domains own law and bind Product-changing work; concurrent Domain overlap requires version-pinned resolution; Initiative remains secondary context; SQLite remains sole local authority. CD-0042 amends only the pre-go-live agent-surface sequencing.
title: Architecture-bound Product law is Concord's primary coordination model
